assertions.name: the_fibre_dimension_cannot_carry_a_colour_index

assertions.name: the_colour_index_reading_is_catastrophically_refuted

assertions.name: the_total_exchange_reading_gives_a_STRICT_bound_but_a_loose_one

assertions.name: the_two_readings_bracket_the_corpus_choice

assertions.name: removing_the_asymmetry_improves_but_does_not_fix_the_symmetry_energy

assertions.name: no_derivation_of_the_assignment_was_found
